note: RFC 8210 Section 5.10 requires implementations to compare Subject Public Key values as well as SKIs when detecting duplicate Router Key PDUs. TestRFC8210RouterKeyDuplicateComparesSPKIAndSKI exercises real TCP RTR sessions over RTRSession.syncOnce -> handlePDU -> parseRouterKeyPDU -> applyStagedRouterKey (which keys on {SKI [20]byte, ASN uint32, SPKI string}). Positive covers both v1 and v2: announces two Router Keys sharing the same SKI and ASN with distinct SPKIs, a third with a different SKI and identical SPKI/ASN, and a fourth with a different ASN and identical SKI/SPKI, asserting clean sync, io.EOF (no Error Report), all 4 keys retained, and an incremental withdrawal removing only the matching {SKI, ASN, SPKI} while preserving its colliding-SKI sibling. Negative proves true duplicate detection on identical {SKI, ASN, SPKI} both within one sync and across a subsequent incremental Serial Query sync, asserting errRtrDuplicateRouterKey, exact Error Report code 7 encapsulating the offending Router Key PDU, and session close. Both polarities carry verified revert discrimination records against applyStagedRouterKey.
